name: Alor Setar

queries.query: Malaysia official cadastral map parcel viewer Alor Setar Kedah lot map API JUPEM
queries.result: Official discovery found JUPEM's eBiz interactive map for digital cadastral lots, the JUPEM eKadaster login service, the PLANMalaysia i-Plan public geoportal with a Lot Kadaster layer, and official Kota Setar land-office/MBAS pages. No anonymous Alor Setar parcel response was exposed.

queries.query: peta kadaster rasmi Malaysia Alor Setar Kedah lot tanah JUPEM
queries.result: Malay-language official discovery confirmed JUPEM as the cadastral custodian and identified digital cadastral lots, the Kota Setar land office, and i-Plan's Lot Kadaster/Carian Lot interfaces. The public routes did not provide a safe anonymous geometry-and-ID response for the WUP point.

researchNote: Official custodians and public map/procedure routes were evidenced, but no local anonymous parcel service was qualified and no parcel sample is retained. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
